dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Ah, esteemed customer! I see a golden glow upon your brow — fortune favors you these days! Coincidentally, I've got just the luck-boosting trinkets to keep that wealth rolling in. Come closer and take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you got, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Why, everything and anything, of course. Take a look at this adeptus-crafted Sigil of Permission. It will surely guarantee you fair winds and calm roads as your travels take you through Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: And behold this exquisite medallion carved from the finest Clearwater Jade. It can enhance your spiritual energies, ward off calamity and evil spirits, and even drive away misfortune.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Well? Not to your tastes? How about this? Here I have some caligraphy personally written by Rex Lapis! Perhaps this will win you over...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for your kind words.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Oh, you're not coming to browse my wares? What a pity...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these... real?

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: How could they be anything but? Don't just look at what's written on them... behold the brilliant colors, the glossy patinas! How could they be fake?

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: That's not mud you can sling about lightly!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: You have wonderful intuition, esteemed customer. I was indeed originally a merchant from Liyue, and I came to Snezhnaya to engage in tea trade.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: But the business... Well, let's just say there were some hiccups, which is how I ended up here.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: But who knew this place would be so full of outstanding folks? Turns out, they adore way more about Liyue's culture than just our tea. So I've settled down here — now, I offer the locals our hometown wisdom and wares!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Oh, my, Lady Nefer! Are you looking to buy? Whatever you want, I'll give you a discount!

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: ...Might I also inquire about the antique buyers you were helping me find...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've already sent representatives to contact them. As soon as there's news, I'll let you know.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: O—Okay... Wonderful! There really is nothing you can't do, Lady Nefer!

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Once everything's settled, I'll pick out the best item I have as a gift to show my gratitude!
